example.title: House, 205 4th St. SW, Sturdevant Southwest Historic District

brief: Freshly restored two-storey Italianate/Queen Anne frame house in slate-blue lap siding with crisp white trim: a square centre tower rising a half storey above the roof with a gabled cap and a tall arched window, a front gable wing with a one-storey canted bay window, and a two-level front porch - turned posts and spindle rail below, a glassed-in sleeping porch with a band of windows above. Hydrangeas along the porch, a newly seeded lawn.
